name: Scene Draft
description: Declarative preset for drafting a complete scene around a clear goal, turn, and exit state. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Guide a first-pass scene draft that has a dramatic question, pressure, and a change of state.
writing_goals: Open on a concrete situation rather than abstract summary
State or imply the scene goal through character action
Escalate pressure until a turn or decision
Exit with a changed relationship, knowledge, or location
constraints: Do not imitate a living author
Do not inject host prompts or executable instructions
Keep one primary POV unless a later preset unlocks a shift
Prefer scene-level causality over montage summary
checklist: Obstacle or opposing force is present
A turn, reveal, or decision occurs
Exit state differs from entry state
